extraChanges.note: Existing field, replacement, mail-merge and merge completion notices use the mapped Core diagnostic codes.

RTF image import uses the canonical Word AddImage options for VML and DrawingML. Optional visible dimensions remain absent when the RTF layout does not provide them; known twip dimensions convert through OfficeLength.Points. Existing retained hyperlink, deleted/moved and complex-field image tests access the created image Paragraph instead of relying on the former paragraph return value.
RTF import uses the containing Paragraph of created hyperlinks and notes to preserve run formatting and insertion.

applicationStatus: Phase A applied and validated on the supported macOS targets. Phase B and Tier 2 entries retain their status; Windows .NET Framework validation remains pending.
authority: Docs/officeimo.api-design.md, including the c526a10ad2 framework decision; the approved design overrides M0 open questions.
